headline: Tabled a three-year rental inspection exemption for Altitude Apartments until November; approved prior minutes.
summary: Discussion covered past inspections and outstanding invoices at Altitude Apartments. The director's September report listed three active tuberculosis cases, 63 rental units inspected, and 28 housing complaint inspections.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the September 16, 2026 meeting 2-0.
Tabled, 2-0, a motion to postpone the three-year inspection exemption for Altitude Apartments to November.
